text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"three organized body paragraphs on efficiency, safety, and convenience","quality":"organization","description":"The essay groups its reasons into clearly separated sections that make the argument easy to follow."},{"evidence":"“use half the fuel of today's taxis” and “sensors… detect and respond”","quality":"source use","description":"The essay draws on specific details from the article to support its claims rather than relying mostly on opinion."},{"evidence":"explains lower fuel use leading to less CO2 and pollution","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay develops its points with added explanation instead of just stating them."},{"evidence":"repeated “more safe” and “more convenient” claims tied to article facts","quality":"development of reasoning","description":"The essay connects evidence to its position in a more sustained way, showing why the cited facts support the argument."},{"evidence":"“This idea is the next big innovation in human history” and “It is time to advance”","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends with a stronger sense of closure and a more emphatic final position."}]}
